name: ES9038Q2M Katana
description: The `es9038q2m_katana` platform allows ESPHome devices to control DAC boards that expose an ES9038Q2M through an Allo Katana-compatible control interface.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the control interface. Defaults to `0x30`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the I²C bus the device is connected to.

config_entries.label: Bits Per Sample
config_entries.description: The audio sample bit depth written to the format register during startup. One of `16bit`, `24bit`, or `32bit`. Defaults to `16bit`.

config_entries.label: Deemphasis
config_entries.description: Selects the de-emphasis curve. One of `bypass`, `32khz`, `44_1khz`, or `48khz`. Defaults to `bypass`.

config_entries.label: Dop
config_entries.description: Enables DoP mode on the control interface. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Filter Shape
config_entries.description: Selects the DAC digital filter. One of `linear_phase_fast`, `linear_phase_slow`, `minimum_phase_fast`, `minimum_phase_slow`, `apodizing`, `hybrid`, or `brick_wall`. Defaults to `apodizing`.

config_entries.label: Sample Rate
config_entries.description: The sample rate written to the format register during startup. One of `44100`, `48000`, `88200`, `96000`, `176400`, `192000`, `352800`, or `384000`. Defaults to `48000`.
